text.body:
no. 4078 title. kaumāra saṃhitā extent. 28 subject. tantram
pṛ0 1a) ||śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ||dvābhyāṃvibhrājamānaṃvarakanakamahā śṛṃkhalābhyāṃbhujābhyāṃ||vījāpūrādivibhraddaśabhujala- litaṃcaṃdracūḍaṃtrinetraṃ||saṃdhyāsiṃdūravarṇaṃstanabharanamitaṃ tudilaṃsammitaṃtaṃ||kaṃṭhādūrddhaṃkarīdraṃyuvatiyūmadhaḥstau mividyāgaṇeśaṃ||1||samastāyudhasaṃpūrṇaṃsadbhujadvādaśā śritaṃ||adhastādvanitākāramādyaṃvaṃdegajānanaṃ||2||ra jatāditaṭeramyemunivṛṃdaniṣevite||kalpadrumaiḥpa-
pṛ0 1ba) rivṛteśikharekanakojvale||3||ratnastaṃbhasahastraistuśo- bhiteratnamaṃḍape||ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhaṃdraṣṭuṃdevyāmahe- śvaraṃ||samāgatohavrahmāsmipraṇipatyakṛpānidhiṃ||va ddhāṃjalipuṭobhūtvātuṣṭāvaparameśvaraṃ||5||vrahmovāca||na maḥśivāyadevāyasaccidānaṃdamūrttaye||namovedāṃtave- dyāpayogināṃguravenamaḥ||6||namastecaṃdracūḍāyalokā nugrahakāriṇe||vrahmaviṣṇusvarūpāyasarvabhūtā-
pṛ0 2a) tmanenamaḥ||7||evaṃstutvāmahādevaṃpraṇamaṃtaṃmuhurmuhuḥ ||prāhagaṃbhīrayāvācābhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ||8||svā gataḥkiṃtavavrahmankvacitsṛṣṭiḥkriyāstuvāstotre- ṇānenatuṣṭosmikimāgamakāraṇāṃ||9||ityuktavaṃtaṃ deveśaṃvidhātāvyaktamavrīta||navācyamihadeveśatva- yāviśvātmanāprabho||1||tvatprasādadṛśaṃnānyat||kiṃ phalamādṛśāṃmahat||tathāpiśrotumichāmirahasyaṃmana-
pṛ0 2ba) sthitaṃ||12||upāsitavyodeveśaḥsarvairapicadevataiḥ||mahā- māyāmahāvidyādevīviśvamayīkila||12||māyayāni rmitaṃsarvaṃjagadetaccarācaraṃ||ityuktaṃbhagavatāpūrvaṃparavrahma mayīticā||13||tasyavighneśvaraṃdevaṃśrīvidyāsahitaṃpa raṃ||tanmaṃtraṃyaṃtrādipuraścaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ||14||sarvaṃvadastvaṃ kṛpayāpāhimāṃbhaktavatsala||īśvaruvāca|śṛṇuvrahmanyathā nyāyaṃvidyāgaṇapatiṃprabhuṃ||15||sarvaiśvaryapradaṃdivyaṃsarva-
pṛ0 3a) lokavimohanaṃ||dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃsādhanaṃsarvasi- ddhidaṃ||16||ṛṣirvidyāgaṇeśasyadakṣiṇāmūrtirucyate chaṃdosyadevīgāyatrīdevovidyāguṇeśvaraḥ||17||gaṃvījaṃhrīṃta- taḥśaktirviniyogaprayojane||paṃcavījasamāyuktaṃumi- tyādiṣaḍaṃgakaṃ||18||asyadhyānaṃpravakṣyāmividyāgaṇa pateprabhoḥ||karīṃdravadanaṃdevaṃtrinetraṃcaṃdrasekharaṃ||adha- stādvanitākāraṃsiṃdūrāruṇavigrahaṃ||19||uttuṃgastana
pṛ0 3ba) bhārodyadratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ||kvaṇatkiṃkiṃṇikākāṃcī maṇinūpurabhūṣitaṃ||20||vījāpūraṃgadāmikṣucāpaṃśūlā divārijaṃ||pāśotpalaṃcavrīhyagraṃsvadaṃtaṃratnakuṃbhakaṃ||21 ||vibhratsakaṃkaṇaihastaiścārubhyāṃhemaśṛṃkhalāṃ||vibhrājamā naṃvighneśaṃdhyāyetsarvārthasiddhaye||22||evaṃdhyātvājape nnityaṃprātaḥṣoḍaśavārakaṃ||sarvānkāmānvāpnotivi ghneśaḥprasīdati||23||maṃtroddhāraṃpravakṣyāmivighnarājasya
pṛ0 4a) dhīmate||praṇavaṃpaṃcavījānividyāprathamakhaṃḍataṃ||24|| gaṇapateścaturthyaṃtaṃdviptīyaṃkhaṃḍamuddharet||varadadvayamuccā- ryyatṛtīyaṃkhaṃḍamuccaret||25||paścātsarvajanamitivaśamā nayasaṃyutaṃ||svāhetyuktāgaṇeśasyamaṃtroyaṃsarvasiddhidaṃ ||26||dhanadhānyapradaṃsadyasarvalokavaśaṃkaraṃ||āyuṣkaraṃprajā vṛddhikaraṃvyādhivināśakṛt||27||imaṃmaṃtraṃpragṛhṇīyātsa dgurormukhasaṃśrutaṃ||guṇānvitaṃgaṇīdhīśaṃbhaktaṃmaṃtrevicakṣa
pṛ0 4ba) ṇaṃ||28||dayānvitaṃpraśāṃtaṃcapāraṃparyyakramānvitaṃ||samya kjñātavāpragṛhṇīyādvidyāgaṇapateprabhoḥ||29||ubhābhyāmapi gṛhṇīyādgubhābhyāṃsarvasiddhaye||ubhayoraikyasaṃvaṃdhādrahasya midamīritaṃ||30||ariktapāṇirgatvātumaṃtrārthaṃgurusaṃ- nidhau||gurusaṃtoṣayanpaścādgṛhṇīyānmaṃtramuttamaṃ||31|| itiśrīkaumārasaṃhitāyāṃsadāśivavrahmāsaṃvādevi dyārahasyevidyāgaṇeśamaṃtroddhāronāmaprathamoddhāraḥ1
pṛ0 5a) athātaḥsaṃpravakṣyāmipuraruścaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ||parvatāgrenadī tīresiddhadevālayegṛhe||1||ekāṃtevijanesthāneśucaude śeviśeṣataḥ||āsīnaḥprāṅmukhobhūtvācāsanekachapā sane||2||kadaṃvara(pāda)mayevāpijapenmaṃtrasyasiddhaye||anāsa nasthoyaḥkuryyādimaṃmaṃtrajapaṃnaraḥ||3||dehāyāsaparaṃta syadevatānaṃprasīdati||darbhāsaneekamekaṃsyāccarmātva ṣṭaguṇaṃbhavet||4||viṣṭareṣoḍaśaguṇaṃkarmarproktaṃśataguṇaṃbhavet
pṛ0 5ba) upaviśyāsaneśuddheguruṃdhyātvāsamāhitaṃ||5||śrīguru paramaṃcaivaparāparaguruṃtataḥ||yonimudrāṃpradarśyāthanama skuryātsvamūrddhanī||6||tatogaṇapatiṃdurgāṃkṣetrapālaṃsa rasvatīṃ||dakṣavāṃmāṃsajānvoścanyasedvadanapūrvakaṃ||7|| abhyarcyādhāraśaktyaivanamītyāsanaṃprati||śuddhamātṛ- kayānyāsyakuṃkuṃmanyāsamācaret||8||akārādikṣa- kārāṃtaṃmūlamaṃtrevinyaset||tataḥprathamakhaṃḍaṃcakhaṃḍa
pṛ0 6a) dvayamataḥparaṃ||9||khaṃḍatrayamātṛkayākuṃkumanyāsamuttamaṃ ||evaṃnyasyamahānyāsaṃmaṃtranyāsamathācaret||10||aṣṭotta raṃsahasraṃtujapenmaṃtramananyadhīḥ||daśāṃśaṃtarpaṇaṃcaivahomaṃvrā hmaṇabhojanaṃ||11||pravakṣyetarpaṇaṃvrahmanjapakālaṃtusāṃpra taṃ||aṃtyayāmaṃsamārabhyajapedāsūryadarśanāt||12||gaṃdhoda kaṃsakarpūraṃmadayuktaṃsapuṣpakaṃ||saṃgṛhyatāmrapātrekāṃsye vāpyathamṛnmaye||13||viṃdutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇaṃaṣṭaṣoḍaśa
pṛ0 6ba) patrakaṃ||vṛttatrayaṃcadharaṇīsadanatrayamevavā||14||vrahmavi dyāgaṇeśasyapūjāyaṃtramitismṛtaṃ||etadyaṃtraṃjalenyasyavi ghnarājamatarpayet||15||maṃtranyāsaṃtataḥkṛtvādhyātvāvidyā gaṇeśvaraṃ||tarpayenmastaketasyaratnakuṃbhābhiṣecanaṃ||16||i tyevaṃtarpayenityaṃmaṣṭottaraśataṃpunaḥ||tarpaṇāṃtetunaivedyaṃnā likeraṃsakaṃdakaṃ||17||japādaucatathākuryādvighneśāyama hātmane||ayutatritayaṃkuryājjapaṃmaṃtrasyasiddhaye||18||pra
pṛ0 7a) sādārthaṃgaṇeśasyapravakṣyehomamuttamaṃ||kuṃḍaṃsalakṣaṇaṃkṛ- tvāmekalātrayaśobhitaṃ||19||aratnimātravistīrṇaṃcatu rasraṃsamaṃtataḥ||kuṃḍaṃsaṃprokṣyavidhivallipinyāsamathācare t||20||viṃdutrikoṇaṣaṭkoṇamaṣṭapatraṃtuvinyaset|| kuṃḍeviṣṇupratiṣṭhāpyataddaśāṃśaṃparityajet||21||paryyukṣya caparīstīryyaprakuryātpātrasādhanaṃ||praṇītāṃprokṣiṇīṃ caivājyasthālīṃsnavaṃjuhaṃ||22||kuṃḍasyāṃtaratovrahman
pṛ0 7ba) saṃsādhyaṃvidhipūrvakaṃ||pavitravatyāṃprokṣaṇyāmāpūryasa- lilaṃtataḥ||23||āpodevīritiproktāāpoevaistulajja pai||prokṣitāstutribhiprokṣyapaṃcaśuddhiṃvidhāyaca||24||pra ṇītāstusamāpūryavaruṇosītimaṃtrataḥ||agneruttarata sthāpyavaruṇaṃparipūjayet||25||athājyasaṃskārāṃtāṃttu kṛtvāsrukasuvamārjanaṃ||aṃtarvahisthādevaṃcadaṃḍaṃdarbhaistu mārjayet||26||paridhīnparidhāyāthiṃdhānagnausamarppa
pṛ0 8a) yet||athāgniṃmaṃtranyāsaṃcakṛtvādhyātvāsamāhitaḥ||27|| āvāhyajihvāsaṃpūjyamūrttiraṣṭautataḥparaṃ||ādhārāṃcājya- bhāgaucakṛtvāgniṃparipūjayet||28||pīṭhapūjāṃtataḥkuryādvi dyāgaṇapateḥprabhoḥ||sudhāsamudramabhyarcyakalpavṛkṣatataḥparaṃ ||29||maṇidvīpaṃtathāvrahmanpṛthvīdvīpāvatīpuna||ratna maṃḍapamadhyeturatnasiṃhāsanaṃtathā||30||ādhāraśaktiṃsaṃpū jyamūlaprakṛtimevaca satvaṃrajastamaścaivatīvrādhānavaśa
pṛ0 8ba) ktayaḥ||31||dharmādīnapyadharmādīnparipūjyayathā- kramaṃ||ātmānamaṃtarātmānaṃparamātmānamevaca||32||e- vaṃkrameṇasaṃpūjyadevaṃvidyāgaṇeśvaraṃ||gaṇānāṃtvetimaṃtre smapuṣpairāvāhayetprabhuṃ||33||dvādaśabhujamaruṇābhaṃgajavada naṃvaradamaṃganākāraṃ||divyamaṇibhūṣitāṃgaṃdevaṃvidyāgaṇe śvaraṃdevaṃ||34||evaṃdhyātvāgaṇādhīśaṃsaṃpūjyavidhipūrva- kaṃ||ājyāhutiṃhunetvrahmanaṣṭotaraśataṃsudhī||35||
pṛ0 9a) aṣṭaudravyaihutevrahman||aṣṭottaraśatāhutiṃpunaścājyāhuṃtiṃ kāryādvāviṃśatsaṃkhyayāvidho(bho)||35||parivārānvinākāryā nmūlamaṃtreṇavuddhimān||puraścaraṇahometuparivārānnacā rcayet||37||pūrṇāhuṃtiṃhutemaṃtraṃjaptvāṣoḍaśavārakaṃ||prā yaścittāhutiṃkuryyānmahāvyāhṛtipūrvakaṃ||38||pāyasā nnairapūpaiścapānīyairamṛtopamaiḥ||prasannapūjāsaṃkalpāsatāṃ vūlaṃnivedayet||39||pūrvavatpunararbhyarcyakuryātpuṣpāṃjaliṃ
pṛ0 9ba) prabho||bhagavaṃtamathadhyātvāpaṃcamudrāprardarśayet||40||sa- guṇaṃnirguṇīkṛtyasaccidānaṃdavigrahaṃ||vāmanāsāpuṭe- naivahṛtpadmebhāvayetprabhuṃ||41||cinmayatvamanuprāpyapari vārānvitobhavet||mamahṛtkamalaṃprāpyasthitobhavavi nāyakaḥ||42||itijaptvāsvamātmānaṃmarcayedgaṃdhapuṣpakaiḥ ||vahnimātmanisaṃyojyamaṃtrametamudīrayet||43||ūṃbhū- rbhuvaḥsvaromehyagneupatiṣṭasvātmānaṃpāhime||ityuktā
pṛ0 10a) prajapenmūlamaṃtraśaktyanurūpataḥ||44||ityevaṃmaṃḍalaṃkuryātpu raścaraṇamuttamaṃ||svayaṃkarttumaśaktaścedupāyaṃpravīmite||45||vi dyāgaṇeśabhaktaiścavidyātaṃtravicakṣaṇaiḥ||sādhubhirjapaśīlai ścajapatarpaṇahomaṃkaṃ||46||kārayenmaṃḍalaṃbhaktyārdhamaṃḍa lamevavā||caturbhivrāhmaṇaivrahmanācāryeṇasamanvitaṃ||47 ||kalaucetkiṃguṇaṃkuryātjapatarpaṇahomakaṃ||anyairvā kārayedbhaktyāsaṃkhyāyāścaturguṇaṃ||48||sūryodayaṃsamāra
pṛ0 10ba) bhyayāmātpurvasamācaret||ṛtvijaṃtutathācāryaṃgadhapuṣpākṣa tādibhiḥ||49||ārabhya(abhyarcya)vidhivadbhaktyādhyāyanvidyāgaṇeśva raṃ||pāyasānnaiḥphalāpūpairbhakṣairbhojyauścabhojayet||50||ma dakṣiṇāṃkaṃtāṃvūlaṃnatvātebhyodinedine||japata rpaṇahomaṃcagṛhṇīyāddānapūrvakaṃ||51||japa(dānamaṃtra)tarpaṇahomaṃca sarvavidyāgaṇeśvaraṃ||dāsyāmidakṣiṇāṃgṛhṇantubhyaṃdevaḥ prasīdatu||52||evamuccāryayenmaṃtraṃgṛhṇīyātsaphalaṃpha-
pṛ0 11a) laṃ||sadyaḥprasannobhagavānsarvakāmānprayachati||53|| sidhyaṃtisarvakarmāṇinaśyaṃtiripavastasthā||tadārabhyaga ṇādhīśaḥsarvasyaivabhavedhruvaṃ||54||itiśrīkaumārasaṃ hitāyāṃpuraścaraṇavidhidvitīyodhyāyaḥ||2||pūjāvi dhānakaṃvranpravakṣyāmitavāgrataḥ||pūjāmātreṇasaṃtuṣṭaḥ suprasannobhavedhruvaṃ||54||yaścaṃdrasūryagrahaṇetukāśyāṃ sahasraliṃgārccanamarccanāccā||vivarccanaṃvighnapatesvavidyā
pṛ0 11ba) pūjākalāṃśailasamanameti||55||idaṃrahasyaṃparamaṃguhyā- dguhyaṃtaraṃvaraṃ||dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃkāraṇaṃvasa(śya)sādhanaṃ ||56||ākāraṃrogaharaṇaṃsarvaśatruvināśanaṃ||aṃtyayā mesamutthāyapūjākarmasamārabhet||57||ekāṃtevijane sthāneśucaudeśevicakṣaṇaḥ||gomayenasamālipyadi- vyadhūpaiḥsudhūpakaiḥ||58||upaviśyāsaneramyeprāṅmukho daṅmukhopivā||karaśuddhiṃvidhāyāthamātṛkānyāsamā
pṛ0 12a) caret||59||vinyasyasvasyadehetukuṃkumanyāsamācaret ||viṃbevāhemacakrevārajatevāthatāmrake||60||ātma pūjāṃpurākuryāccakrapūjāṃtataḥparaṃ||ratnasiṃhāsanaṃdhyā tvāpīṭhapūjāṃcapūrvavat||61||madhyevighneśamāvāhyaga- ṇānāṃtvetimaṃtrataḥ||aśeṣaguṇakalyāṇavidyāgaṇa patevibho||yātpūjākaromyatratāvatvaṃsusthirobhava||62|| itipuṣpāṃjaliṃdatvāpadmamudrāṃprardarśayet||63||apa
pṛ0 12ba) sarpaṃtuyebhūtāyebhūtābhuvisaṃsthitāḥ||yebhūtāvighnakartā raḥstenaśyaṃtuśivājñayā||64||apasarpaṃtuyebhūtāiti bhūtaśuddhiṃsamācaret||puraḥśaṃkhaṃprathiṣṭhāpyatricatuḥ- koṇamaṃḍale||65||gaṃdhatoyaiḥsamāpūryadhenumudrāṃprada- rśayet||gaṃgaṃcayamunecetitīrthānyāvāhyacārcayet66 svātmānaṃpūjayedvrahmanpūjopakarṇānica||pādyārghamā camanīyaṃcamadhuparkādikaṃvibho||67|| datvāsugaṃdha
pṛ0 13a) puṣpābhidhūpadīpausamarppayet||pūjādravyaṃsamānīya kṣīraṃtrimadhurānvitaṃ||68||dravyapūjitakuṃbhaṃtugaṃdhapuṣpai samarppayet||darśayetdhenumudrāṃcayonimudrāṃtataḥparaṃ69 ||amṛtīkaraṇaṃkuryānmudrāmatāmudīrayan||haṃsaḥśu ciṣadityuktāprakṣadviṣṇoranaṃtaraṃ||70||tryaṃvakaṃcatatoja- ptvāmṛtodbhavamaṃtrakaṃ||japtvāpunastusaṃpūjyaamṛtenā rcayedvibhuṃ||71||sauvarṇaṃrājataṃtāmraṃkāṃsyaṃvānālikera
pṛ0 13ba) rajaṃ||pātrapaṃcakamāpūryasudhayāvighnanāyakaṃ||72||arccaye tpuṣpavṛṃdābhyāṃtriṃśadvāraṃsamaccayet||māṣapūpaṃniyamyā thamodakaiḥpānakādibhiḥ||73||pāyasānnaiphalayutairnai(nānāvarṇe) vavargairapūpakaiḥ||karpūramiśratāṃvūrairnivedyavidhivattathā ||74||nīrājanaṃtatodatvāparivārāstatorcayet|| trikoṇāgretarormūleramāṃcaivaramāpatiṃ||75||dakṣiṇeva- ṭamūlecagirijāṃgirijāpatiṃ||paścimeśvatthamūlecara
pṛ0 14a) tiṃratipatiṃtathā||76||uttaretupriyaṃgaiścamūlebhuvi(na)rāha kaṃ||tatopāśānidigbhāgepuṣṭidevaṃgaṇādhipaṃ||77||ca turvāraṃsamabhyarcyatatraśrīpādukāmiti||amṛtaṃvāmaha stenaanyenakusumāni*||78||gṛhītvābhyarcyayedevaṃtri vāraṃmūlavidyayā||ratyaṃtyaṃvāṃcamahādevīṃprītyaṃvāṃcamano bhavāṃ||79||caturvāraṃsamabhyarcyagaṇeśaṃmūlavidyayā|| athaṣaṭkoṇakevrahmanyajetṣaṇmīthunaṃkramāt||80||
